description: A shell script ('generate-cmdlist.sh') used for generating command list C source code, including category definitions, command descriptions, and associated data structures. The script processes command list files and documentation to produce a C source output.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits the script with status 1.

methods.name: command_list
methods.description: Reads command names and their rest of the line from a file, filtering out comments, empty lines, and excluded programs, then outputs a processed list.

methods.name: category_list
methods.description: Extracts unique command categories from the list of commands.

methods.name: define_categories
methods.description: Defines command category macros based on a list of categories.

methods.name: define_category_names
methods.description: Creates an array of category name strings for use in C code.

methods.name: print_command_list
methods.description: Outputs a C array of command structures, including command names, help descriptions, and categories, by processing documentation files.

search-terms: shell script for command list generation
